title: Completing a restricted sign vector
statement: Given a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define its completion by retaining $x_i$ at each free coordinate, setting coordinates fixed to $1$ equal to $1$, and setting coordinates fixed to $-1$ equal to $-1$.
